digest.component_or_area: LLM provider factory / OpenAI-compatible endpoint support
propositions: The loud refusal in _pai_check_config (runner.py:718) rejects valid base_url and api_key configurations despite documented support for local servers like LMStudio and Ollama.

The openai provider builder must register conditionally only when cfg.base_url is set, preserving the lazy model-STRING path for bare openai strings and keeping the SDK optional for users without custom endpoints.

The profile override must withdraw supports_json_schema_output=False only for custom endpoints while preserving other capabilities, delivered via a rebar OpenAIProvider subclass overriding model_profile staticmethod.
base_url is provider configuration (injected by rebar), not provider selection (which remains driven by the model string and REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER environment variable).
The openai SDK must be added to the dev extra only (not agents runtime extra) so tests can run in CI while maintaining opt-in runtime posture for users.
